name: Excellency And Glory Of The Church The
overview: Scripture reveals the Church's excellency and glory as rooted in God's divine favor and the gathering of His people from all nations, as depicted in Isaiah 60:4-9. The Church is portrayed as a radiant assembly, with sons and daughters coming from afar, bringing gifts and praises to the Lord, highlighting its eminent position as the temple and bride of Christ. This glory is augmented by the increase of its members and their sanctification, reflecting the perfection of beauty and strength derived from Christ and God, who delights in the Church as the seat of His worship.
